body.title: Write the code-reference page script
body.summary: Create src/docgen/render/code-ref-script.ts, which imports from neither page shell and exports CODE_REF_SCRIPT. The script marks each element whose own text holds a code reference (a path with a directory part, an optional :N, :N-M or :N:C), records the marked element and position at pointerdown in a capture-phase listener, and on a click that moved at most 4 pixels posts { type: 'insrc-open-code-ref', path, line? } to the parent. It marks elements without splitting text nodes, stops no event, leaves pointer capture alone, and runs once on load and again when asked after a diagram is drawn.
acceptanceChecks: An element whose text holds a path and line is marked and a click posts that path and line; a path with no line posts the path alone
Text with no reference, and a bare file name, are not marked and post nothing
Marking changes no text node, and the script stops no event and does not touch pointer capture
A click on a marked box inside a viewport that captures the pointer posts the reference, and a press, a move past 4 pixels and a release posts nothing
